title: Local business site
description: Build a small site for an independent bakery. Hero, about, menu highlights, hours, contact. Real, grounded copy.
prompt: Build a site for 'Hearth & Crumb', an independent bakery in Portland, ME. Include a hero with a quiet hand-set feel, an about blurb, three menu highlights, hours, and a contact card. The audience is local — favor plain prose over marketing-speak.

rubric.label: Hero feels hand-set, not stock template
rubric.guidance: Type, weight, and color are intentional.

rubric.label: About reads as a person wrote it
Three menu highlights with real-sounding items
Contact info present (address, phone or form)
